title: Unit and scenario schemas
responsibility: Defines validated unit contracts, execution targets, dependency kinds and scenario evidence requirements.

outputs.name: unitIdPattern
outputs.description: Pattern for lowercase alphanumeric identifiers separated by single dots or dashes.

outputs.name: dependencyVias
outputs.description: Allowed dependency relations, including imports, reexports, dynamic imports, require, URL/style references, process, HTTP, Wasm and contract.

outputs.name: runtimeKinds
outputs.description: Execution kinds module, wasm, process and http.

outputs.name: performanceMetrics
outputs.description: Budgeted latency, throughput and memory metric names.

outputs.name: contractItemSchema
outputs.description: Strict name/type contract-item schema with optional description. Name/type are trimmed and nonempty.

outputs.name: unitDependencySchema
outputs.description: Strict dependency schema naming a unit, allowed relation and declared/derived origin, with optional contract.

outputs.name: performanceBudgetSchema
outputs.description: Strict performance budget schema with workload, supported metric, optional target and tolerance from zero through 0.05.

outputs.name: executionTargetSchema
outputs.description: Strict execution-target schema with supported kind, nonempty entry and optional environment/handler.

outputs.name: componentManifestSchema
outputs.description: Strict version 1 unit schema covering identity, declared/derived responsibility, active/retired state, ownership, contract, dependencies, runtime targets, scenarios, optional public/internal catalog visibility, preview/lineage and frozen budgets.

outputs.name: scenarioManifestSchema
outputs.description: Strict version 1 scenario schema for UI/headless/audio cases, units, state coverage, viewports, tests and evidence requirements.
